How to Test Minity Dark Easily with Stylish

  1. Download the Stylish addon/extension for your browser. Stylish for Firefox • Google Chrome/Chromium • Safari • Opera.

  2. Install Minity Dark theme for Stylish. Navigate to Minity Dark's Stylish page on userstyles.org and click the Install with Stylish button.

  3. Go to WhoaVerse and enable the theme with the Stylish extension. Click on the Stylish button in your browser and select Minity Dark from the list.

  4. Browse WhoaVerse and report any issues with the theme that you see.

Note: Subverses with custom styles may look weird and is expected; Stylish overwrites styles on top of the custom subverse CSS. In order to avoid problems, I recommend disabling custom subverse styles in your account settings.
